name: Intel 8051 Binary Counter
desc: Intel 8051 - 8-bit binary counter on P1 port. Increments from 0x00 to 0xFF and repeats.
code:
; Intel 8051 - 8-bit Binary Counter on P1
; Connect 8 LEDs from P1.0-P1.7 to GND
; Each LED shows one bit of the counter

        ORG 0000H

        MOV A, #00H      ; A = counter value

LOOP:   MOV P1, A        ; Output counter to P1
        ACALL DELAY      ; Wait between counts
        INC A            ; Increment counter (wraps at 255)
        SJMP LOOP        ; Repeat

; Delay subroutine
DELAY:  MOV R2, #02H     ; Moderate delay
DL1:    MOV R3, #0FFH
DL2:    DJNZ R3, DL2
        DJNZ R2, DL1
        RET
        END
